items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: When I went with Basie I recommended Andy to make arrangements for Basie.

ctx.x: Because he was a good arranger.
Oh, he was a fantastic arranger. When I went with Basie I recommended Andy to make arrangements for Basie. He made 'Louisiana' and all those arrangements. And --
How did you come to join Basie, actually? How did that come about?
